messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT: HIGH - gpunode-402 (us-west2a) memory pressure / OOM detected. Auto-page policy 'gpu-oom-auto' fired. PagerDuty incident INC-98765 created, paging @Priya (oncall).

pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC-98765 — Status: Triggered. Escalation policy: GPU-TEAM. Please acknowledge.

Priya (oncall): acked. I’m on it. pulling nvml / kube logs now.

Miguel: seeing spike in 502s from inference-proxy-west2 between 04:30-04:34, ~6-8% error rate. traces show redisconnects + 5xx bursts.

Priya (oncall): ok — checking node metrics. kvcache eviction spikes in the last minute.

Priya (oncall): `kubectl get pods -o wide -n inference --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpunode-402`

Priya (oncall): ```
NAME                               READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   NODE
inference-worker-xyz-1              0/1     OOMKilled 1          2h    gpunode-402
inference-worker-abc-2              1/1     Running   0          3h    gpunode-402
```

Priya (oncall): nvidia-smi snapshot shows GPU0 MEM 98% / 24GB, several processes pinned.

Mike: I'm starting cordon + drain on gpunode-402 to stop new workloads. Will migrate pods to fallback pool.

Mike: `kubectl cordon gpunode-402 && kubectl drain gpunode-402 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n inference`

Priya (oncall): enabling runtime fallback routing for inference-proxy-west2 now — shifting traffic to dedicated-fallback pool. setting route weight to 100% fallback.

Miguel: confirming proxy now sends 100% to fallback. error rate dropping to 1.2% within 30s.

Priya (oncall): root cause looks like kvcache thrash after a recent model rollout (quantized-llama-v2). evictions ~250/s.

Amy (sre-lead): if customers impacted, open bridge. do we have any customer-facing incidents? CS notified?

Priya (oncall): CS notified. affected customers: acme-inc (prod), quickchat (canary) reported 5xx spikes. i've opened a ticket and pinged account leads.

cs-notify-bot: Notified accounts: acme-inc, quickchat — message sent to account owners and CSMs.

Mike: cordon/drain completed. evacuated 5 pods. restarting evicted pods onto gpu-fallback-pool.

Priya (oncall): i'll restart inference-worker processes on fallback and roll back the model rollout for quantized-llama-v2 to previous revision to test.

Priya (oncall): rollback started: `redwoodctl rollout rollback --service=inference --model=quantized-llama-v2 --to=rev-2026-03-12`

Miguel: telemetry shows error rate normalized to baseline ~0.3%. latency back to 95th pct target.

Priya (oncall): monitoring nvml/KV cache: eviction rate falling, GPU mem stable ~60%. looks good.

Amy (sre-lead): good coordination. please keep the incident open for postmortem. assign action items: model rollout validation added, auto-throttle kvcache suggested.

Priya (oncall): assigning follow-ups: (1) postmortem draft, (2) add kvcache eviction alert, (3) add pre-rollout canary with reduced mem footprint.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-98765 — Acknowledged by Priya (oncall) at 2026-03-17T04:35:12Z. Update: Resolved at 2026-03-17T04:49:10Z. Closing alert.

Priya (oncall): closing thread. will post postmortem in #incidents and link to runbook changes. :thumbsup:
